sol-2-1.fix: Treat non-plain class instances as atomic highest-priority values in canMerge/layeredMerge and direct deepMerge; recursively merge only compatible plain records. Add decoded-schema-class private-field getter and identity regressions in MergeStrategy.test.ts and internal/deepMerge.property.test.ts; strengthen the class identity property in MergeStrategy.property.test.ts. Retarget the class-field-copy expectation at MergeStrategy.test.ts:95 while retaining inherited-accessor safety coverage for mergeable records, and update the affected source contract prose/examples in deepMerge.ts and MergeStrategy.ts. Retaining field-wise class merging instead requires an explicit constructor-aware reconstruction path passing the same regressions. The orchestrator handles the verified upstream-bug deviation and adjusted upstream test bookkeeping centrally; do not edit shared ledger or README Port notes.
